comment: Golden retrieval set v2. Authored after the corpus purge that removed all third-party SEO content — every entry below is checked against first-party vendor pages only (Mongo query: find({"company": ...}, {"text":1,"source_url":1}) against rag_chunks). Each query is deliberately phrased in the vocabulary a SALES REP would use, NOT the vendor's own wording, so the eval measures whether embeddings bridge the rep-to-vendor vocabulary gap rather than whether the system can echo docs back verbatim. expect_any substrings were copied character-for-character out of the source chunk text before the query was written. This file must never be tuned, reworded, or loosened based on what retrieval actually returns — it is a blind answer key, not a fitted one. golden_retrieval.json (v1) is a separate, deliberately frozen historical artifact and is not touched by this set.

queries.query: What's the cheapest paid MongoDB Atlas tier and how much does it run per hour?
How much do I need to budget monthly for the smallest production-ready MongoDB cluster?
What encryption protocol locks down connections to the MongoDB database by default?
How many simultaneous connections am I capped at on MongoDB's totally free tier?
What uptime number can I promise a customer running on a paid production MongoDB cluster?
How many geographic zones can I split a worldwide MongoDB cluster into?
Is there a data-size ceiling where MongoDB's automatic migration verification turns off?
Can one MongoDB cluster stretch across two different cloud vendors at the same time?
expect_any: span regions and cloud service providers

queries.query: What's the cheapest paid Pinecone plan and what's the flat monthly fee?
What's the minimum monthly bill on Pinecone's enterprise contract?
How does Pinecone protect data once it's sitting in storage?
Is there a size cap on how big a single Pinecone search response can be?
What uptime number does Pinecone commit to on its top-tier plan?
How does Pinecone actually store vectors behind the scenes?
Does switching from Pinecone's old pod-based setup to serverless cost extra?
Can I run Pinecone fully inside my own cloud account with no vendor SSH access?
expect_any: no SSH, VPN, or inbound access required

queries.query: What do you get on Weaviate's completely free plan?
What's the cheapest monthly price once you leave Weaviate's free tier?
Does Weaviate support single sign-on through my company's identity provider?
How many tenants am I allowed on Weaviate's no-cost plan?
What uptime does Weaviate's entry-level paid plan promise?
What indexing algorithm gives Weaviate fast approximate search at scale?
If my app outgrows Weaviate's free tier, do I have to rebuild anything to go paid?
expect_any: No migration or re-architecting is required

queries.query: Which regions can my dedicated Weaviate deployment actually live in?
expect_any: Any region on AWS, GCP, or Azure
